name: OpenProject Work Packages
description: OpenProject Work Packages API. Create in a project: operation=create_project, id=<project_id>, subject=<title>.
author: ki-basis

operation.description: Required. Prefer create_project to create a work package inside a project (needs id=project_id + subject). One of: project_available_assignees|get_project_collection|create_project|form_create_in_project|list|create|form_create|list_schemas|get_schema|delete|get|update|list_activities|comment|list_activities_emoji_reactions|available_assignees|available_projects_for|list_available_relation_candidates|available_watchers|list_file_links|create_file_link|form_edit|revisions|list_watchers|add_watcher|delete_watcher|list_reminders|create_reminder|workspace_available_assignees|get_workspace_collection|create_workspace|form_create_in_workspace

id.description: For create_project / form_create_in_project / get_project_collection: PROJECT id (ki-pm → 3). For get|update|delete|comment: WORK PACKAGE id. Integer or numeric string.

offset.description: Page number inside the requested collection. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: get_project_collection, list, get_workspace_collection)

pageSize.description: Optional chunk size for a single list request (operations: get_project_collection, list, …). Prefer fetchAll=1 for „alle …“ prompts — do not ask the user to paginate.

fetchAll.description: When 1/true/all on operation=list: return the complete result set. The handler loads OP pages internally (HAL next / high pageSize); the reply must not expose pagination UX. Safety caps: OPENPROJECT_LIST_MAX_ITEMS / MAX_PAGES (if hit: say how many omitted). Auto-set for list prompts containing „alle“.

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. If no filter is to be applied, the client should send an empty array (`[]`). (operations: get_project_collection, list, list_schemas, list_available_relation_candidates, list_file_links, get_workspace_collection)

sortBy.description:
JSON specifying sort criteria.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. (operations: get_project_collection, list, list_available_relation_candidates, get_workspace_collection)

groupBy.description: The column to group by. (operations: get_project_collection, list, get_workspace_collection)

showSums.description: Indicates whether properties should be summed up if they support it. (operations: get_project_collection, list, get_workspace_collection)

select.description: Comma separated list of properties to include. (operations: get_project_collection, list, get_workspace_collection)

notify.description:
Indicates whether change notifications (e.g. via E-Mail) should be sent.
Note that this controls notifications for all users interested in changes to the work package (e.g. watchers, author and assignee),
not just the current user. (operations: create_project, create, update, comment, create_workspace)

displayId.description:
The user-facing identifier for the work package.
Its format depends on the `work_packages_identifier` setting.
When set to `semantic`: the project-based identifier (e.g. "PROJ-42").
When set to `classic`: the numeric ID as a string (e.g. "123"). (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

lockVersion.description: The version of the item as used for optimistic locking — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: create_project, create, update, create_workspace)

status_id.description: Work package status id. On update, sets HAL _links.status.href to /api/v3/statuses/{id}. Resolve names (e.g. abgeschlossen) via openproject-statuses list first.

category_id.description: OpenProject Category id (NL: Tag/Label/Schlagwort). On create/update sets HAL _links.category. Prefer category=name when id unknown — handler resolves via project categories.

category.description: Category id or name (NL Tag/Label). Resolved against /projects/{id}/categories on create_project/update/list filters.

subject.description: Work package title/Betreff. Map user phrases Aufgabe/Task/Ticket/„nennen/heißen X“ → subject=X. Required for create_project|create|update. Never ask the user again if the title was already in the message.

_type.description: Body field _type — enum: WorkPackage (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

description.description: Body field description (operations: create_project, form_create_in_project, create, form_create, update, form_edit, create_workspace, form_create_in_workspace)

scheduleManually.description:
Uses manual scheduling mode when true (default). Uses automatic scheduling
mode when false. Can be automatic only when predecessors or children are
present. (operations: create_project, form_create_in_project, create, form_create, update, form_edit, create_workspace, form_create_in_workspace)

readonly.description: If true, the work package is in a readonly status so with the exception of the status, no other property can be altered. (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

hasProjectAttributes.description: If true, the work package's type has at least one project custom field activated and visible to the current user. (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

startDate.description: Scheduled beginning of a work package (operations: create_project, form_create_in_project, create, form_create, update, form_edit, create_workspace, form_create_in_workspace)

dueDate.description: Scheduled end of a work package (operations: create_project, form_create_in_project, create, form_create, update, form_edit, create_workspace, form_create_in_workspace)

date.description: Date on which a milestone is achieved (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

derivedStartDate.description: Similar to start date but is not set by a client but rather deduced by the work packages' descendants. If manual scheduleManually is active, the two dates can deviate. (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

derivedDueDate.description: Similar to due date but is not set by a client but rather deduced by the work packages' descendants. If manual scheduleManually is active, the two dates can deviate. (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

duration.description:
**(NOT IMPLEMENTED)** The amount of time in hours the work package needs to be completed.
Not available for milestone type of work packages. (operations: create_project, form_create_in_project, create, form_create, update, form_edit, create_workspace, form_create_in_workspace)

estimatedTime.description: Time a work package likely needs to be completed excluding its descendants (operations: create_project, form_create_in_project, create, form_create, update, form_edit, create_workspace, form_create_in_workspace)

derivedEstimatedTime.description: Time a work package likely needs to be completed including its descendants (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

ignoreNonWorkingDays.description:
**(NOT IMPLEMENTED)** When scheduling, whether or not to ignore the non working days being defined.
A work package with the flag set to true will be allowed to be scheduled to a non working day. (operations: create_project, form_create_in_project, create, form_create, update, form_edit, create_workspace, form_create_in_workspace)

position.description:
The position this work package has in a version configured to be backlog (sprint or product).

# Conditions

**Permission** Backlogs needs to be enabled in the work package's project and the work package's type is configured to be a backlog type. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

spentTime.description:
The time booked for this work package by users working on it

# Conditions

**Permission** view time entries (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

storyPoints.description:
The estimation in story points on how long this work package will take to complete

# Conditions

**Permission** Backlogs needs to be enabled in the work package's project and the work package's type is configured to be a backlog type. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

percentageDone.description: Amount of total completion for a work package — integer >= 0 (numeric string ok) (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

derivedPercentageDone.description: Amount of total completion for a work package derived from itself and its descendant work packages — integer >= 0 (numeric string ok) (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

createdAt.description: Time of creation. Can be writable by admins with the `apiv3_write_readonly_attributes` setting enabled. (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

updatedAt.description: Time of the most recent change to the work package. (operations: create_project, create, create_workspace)

_meta.description: Meta information for the work package request {validateCustomFields: boolean} (operations: form_create_in_project, form_create, update, form_edit, form_create_in_workspace)

timestamps.description:
In order to perform a [baseline comparison](/docs/api/baseline-comparisons), you may provide one or several timestamps
in ISO-8601 format as comma-separated list. The timestamps may be absolute or relative,
such as ISO8601 dates, ISO8601 durations and the following relative date keywords: "oneDayAgo@HH:MM+HH:MM",
"lastWorkingDay@HH:MM+HH:MM", "oneWeekAgo@HH:MM+HH:MM", "oneMonthAgo@HH:MM+HH:MM".
The first "HH:MM" part represents the zero paded hours and minutes.
The last "+HH:MM" part represents the timezone offset from UTC associated with the time,
the offset can be positive or negative e.g."oneDayAgo@01:00+01:00", "oneDayAgo@01:00-01:00".

Usually, the first timestamp is the baseline date, the last timestamp is the current date.
Values older than 1 day are accepted only with valid Enterprise Token available. (operations: list, get)

internal.description:
Determines whether this comment is internal. This is only available to users
with `add_internal_comments` permission. It defaults to `false`, if unset. (operations: comment)

query.description: Shortcut for filtering by ID or subject (operations: list_available_relation_candidates)

type.description: Type of relation to find candidates for (default "relates") (operations: list_available_relation_candidates)

user_id.description: User id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete_watcher)

work_package_id.description: Work package id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_reminders, create_reminder)

remindAt.description: The date and time when the reminder is due (operations: create_reminder)

note.description: The note of the reminder (operations: create_reminder)

parent_id.description: Optional parent work package id. Sets _links.parent on create_project/create/update (hierarchy). Alias: parent.

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
